question: Pila ka porsyento ang amusement tax sa admission sa concert kung langyaw nga artist ang mag-perform kumpara sa lokal?
answer: Sa concert kung ang artist ay mga langyaw, ang amusement tax na matutuparan ay 10% lamang, kabilang sa mga nabasa sa [S1] at [S2]. [S1] - 10% from those performed by foreign Artists, [S2] - 10% from those performed by foreign Artists.

ground_truth: Amusement tax on gross admission receipts for musical concerts, theatrical plays, and performances is 10% for performances by foreign artists, and 5% for performances by local artists. Movie premieres follow the same 10% foreign / 5% local rate.
